about.title: About Me
about.description: Full Stack Engineer building scalable systems with NestJS, Next.js, React Native, and .NET — from event-driven microservices to polished mobile apps.
about.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with expertise in building end-to-end solutions across web and mobile platforms using Node.js (NestJS), Next.js/React, React Native, and C# (.NET Core). Experienced in designing scalable systems with Clean Architecture, DDD, microservices, and event-driven patterns. Proficient in both frontend and backend development, with strong DevOps skills in Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. Passionate about delivering high-quality, maintainable code and leveraging modern technologies including AI/prompt engineering to accelerate development.
